description: To whom it may concern, I am writing this letter of recommendation for Nicholas Dilorenzo. Nick is a very special man who worked at my mother's assisted living community. He was always looking out for her best interest, always communicating with me about her health, if she was having a bad day, he would always let me know. title: Triumphs in Advocacy
